warning: Observed input grouping cannot certify hidden macro settings or complete prior state; labels ignored. No native runs. Existing base held fixed; additive corrections only. Selection among these candidates uses same LOFO and is exploratory, not untouched final test.

p2_interaction.interpretation: Positive quality amplitude couples to price: D(P,E)=D0(P)[1+E(P/30)^gamma]. E is learned at price30, not inferred stock law. Three observations cannot uniquely identify structural law. Per-firm cumulative-before and all current nonprice inputs match across p2 price30/50/70.

p1_joint_independent_holdout.note: The p1 heterogeneous prices align positively with R&D; no permutation control exists, so mean-price coupling and covariance cannot be distinguished. Uniform and hetero p1 have identical nonprice decisions/history.

practical_candidate.E_definition: Q_native(uniform30,same_RD_state)/D0(30)-1; zero for no-excess baseline. Stock-to-E law delegated, not inferred here.
practical_candidate.limitations: Price-R&D covariance not identifiable; mixture-R&D validation is one independent p1 family; higher degree terms worsened primary family holdouts.

parent_grouping_verification.controlNote: Groups use same period, firm count, opening capacity/inventory/previous cumulative R&D and native demand-modifier/weight header. Not an assertion of identical full hidden state.
